mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_apply (merchant_id, shop_name, category_ids, contact_name, contact_phone, qualification, status) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{shopName}, #{categoryIds}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{qualification}, 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_apply a
AND a.status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_apply SET status = #{status}, reason = #{reason}, audit_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
